skill.summary: Generates academic research papers in IEEE/ACM formats with standard sections; transitioned to unified paper skill for improved workflow.

latestVersion.changelog:
- This skill is now deprecated and fully integrated into the unified paper entry skill (`paper`).
- Existing commands remain available for backward compatibility but are automatically redirected.
- Users are encouraged to use the new syntax: paper write [section] [topic].
- Provides migration guidance for transitioning to the new workflow.
- Continues to support academic paper creation with standard formatting (IEEE, ACM, ASCE, Elsevier).
